title: 第19章 一起来讨债第20章 专门来捧场的
slug: 九阳武神第4746章是时候清场了
content_zh:
“报告！
吴家家主，刘家家主，梁家家主，谭家家主，陈家家主，周家家主，杨家家主，地宝阁阁主，还有汪家家主，天狼佣兵团的团长……，同时到访！”
突然之间，一个叶家下人，急匆匆走进演武场，大声报告，报了一连串名单。
“他们来干什么？”
叶家的高层们，都是一愣。
这一年族会，叶家没有邀请任何外人。
现在，却一下子，有这么多小家族，小势力纷纷来到。
事情有点突兀。
在圆月城，实力最强的，是秦家，叶家，施家，吕家，合称为四大家族。
但紧跟后面的，最起码，还有几十个小家族，小势力。
毕竟，圆月城是属于大秦帝国三十六座城池的其中之一，规模不算小。
“这些家族和势力，似乎都和我们叶家有生意上的来往。
极有可能，是他们收到风声，知道我们叶家召开族会，所以不请自来，和我们叶家拉拢一下感情。”
叶天鹏沉吟了一下，开声说道。
“应该是这样，快快有请！”
大长老也是点头。
这些到访的家族和势力，虽然整体实力比不上叶家，但叶家不会随便去得罪他们。
“呵呵，叶家主，各位长老，冒昧来访，真是打扰了啦。”
“你们叶家，果然人才济济，不愧是我们圆月城的四大家族之一啊。”
“过奖了，各位光临，我们叶府真是蓬荜生辉啊。”

……
很快，一大批小家族小势力的代表来到演武场，被迎上东边的高台之上就座，双方相互客套了一番。
“咳咳……，叶家主，我这一次来，其实是有一件事。
十天之前，你们叶家，从我这里拿了两千张兽皮，总共八千块灵晶石，到现在还没有付清账。
还望叶家主，马上付清。”
一个身材有点肥胖的中年男子，端起茶杯，喝了几口茶之后，突然沉声说道。
他是陈家家主。
“叶家主，你们叶家，在城南的位置，一直租用我们吴家的十五间临街店铺。
我想通知你，从这个月起，店铺的租金，不再是一年付一次，而是一月一付。
而且，租金翻倍。”
陈家主的话音刚落，吴家主就抢着开口了。
“叶家主，一个月前，你们叶家，从我们刘家拿了三十颗一阶魔兽的兽核。
总共，六千块灵晶石，麻烦今天付清。”
刘家主也说话了。
“叶家主，二十天前，你们叶家从地宝阁赊欠了十颗真灵丹，价值一万块灵晶石，请今天付清吧。”
地宝阁的阁主开声说道。
“叶家主，你们叶家，三个月之前，从我们梁家的兵器铺之中拿走了一百件兵器，价值三千块灵晶石。
我希望，叶家今天能付清。”
梁家主说道。
接着，其他人，也是纷纷开口。

全部，都是来要账的！
事情很不对劲！
这分明，就是专门针对叶家！
content_en:
"Report!
The head of the Wu family, the head of the Liu family, the head of the Liang family, the head of the Tan family, the head of the Chen family, the head of the Zhou family, the head of the Yang family, the head of the Dibao Pavilion, the head of the Wang family, the head of the Sirius mercenary group... all visited at the same time! "
Suddenly, a servant of the Ye family hurried into the martial arts arena, loudly reported, and reported a series of names.
"What are they here for?"
The senior executives of the Ye family were all stunned.
The Ye family did not invite any outsiders to this annual clan meeting.
Now, all of a sudden, so many small families and small forces have arrived.
Things were a bit abrupt.
In Yuanyue City, the most powerful families are the Qin family, the Ye family, the Shi family, and the Lu family, collectively known as the four major families.
But closely behind, at least, there are dozens of small families and small forces.
After all, Yuanyue City is one of the thirty-six cities in the Qin Empire, and its scale is not small.
“These families and forces all seem to have business dealings with our Ye family.
It's very possible that they got wind of the Ye family's clan meeting, so they came uninvited to try to win over the Ye family. "
Ye Tianpeng pondered for a moment and spoke loudly.
"That's how it should be. Please come quickly!"
The great elder also nodded.
Although the overall strength of these visiting families and forces is not as good as that of the Ye family, the Ye family will not offend them casually.
"Haha, Master Ye, elders, you are really disturbing me by taking the liberty of visiting."
"Your Ye family is indeed full of talents. You are worthy of being one of the four major families in our Yuanyue City."
"Thank you very much. Everyone, come here. Our Ye Mansion is really flourishing."
…
Soon, a large number of representatives of small families and small forces came to the martial arts arena and were welcomed to sit on the high platform in the east. Both parties exchanged polite greetings.
"Ahem... Master Ye, I came here this time for one thing.
Ten days ago, your Ye family took 2,000 animal skins and a total of 8,000 pieces of spiritual crystals from me. The bill has not been paid in full yet.
I also hope that Master Ye will pay up immediately. "
A somewhat obese middle-aged man picked up the teacup, drank a few sips of tea, and suddenly said in a deep voice.
He is the head of the Chen family.
"Master Ye, your Ye family has been renting fifteen street-facing shops from our Wu family in the south of the city.
I would like to inform you that starting from this month, the rent of the store will no longer be paid once a year, but once a month.
Moreover, the rent doubled. "
As soon as Patriarch Chen finished speaking, Patriarch Wu rushed to speak.
"Master Ye, a month ago, your Ye family took thirty first-order monster cores from our Liu family.
A total of six thousand spiritual crystals, please pay them off today. "
The head of the Liu family also spoke.
"Master Ye, twenty days ago, your Ye family owed ten true elixirs on credit from Dibao Pavilion, worth ten thousand spiritual crystals. Please pay them off today."
The Pavilion Master of Dibao Pavilion said loudly.
"Master Ye, your Ye family took away one hundred weapons from our Liang family's weapons shop three months ago, worth three thousand spiritual crystals.
I hope the Ye family can pay it off today. "
The head of the Liang family said.
Then, other people also spoke one after another.
All of them are here to demand payment!
Something is very wrong!
This is clearly targeting the Ye family!
